title: Verify: Header bar, plaque, pill with dot and countdown unit tests
summary: Unit tests assert the header structure for a loaded round.
description: New test file proving REQ1 acceptance criteria with the real uiStore and the roundFixture.
acceptance_criteria: Pill, dot, plaque and timer assertions pass.

steps.action: Create the file importing render, screen, cleanup from @testing-library/react, HeaderOverlay and roundFixture from ./fixtures/api (a Round mirroring the backend round JSON in backend round handlers). Add test 'pill holds dot, id and status': render <HeaderOverlay worldTitle="The Boy's Room" round={roundFixture} />; assert getByTestId('round-pill') contains text round-1 and OPEN; assert getByTestId('round-dot') has attribute data-status=OPEN. Add test 'plaque and logo': assert getByText("The Boy's Room").closest('[data-frame="plaque"]') is not null, getByText('StoryForge') present, getByTestId('header-bar') has class sf-brass-corners, getAllByRole('timer') length 1.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/headerKit.test.tsx
